Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

hotel — a building where travellers sleep. Example: I have got a reservation at the hotel.
room — a part of a building with walls. Example: My room is 204.
key — a small object that opens a door. Example: Could I have the key, please?
reservation — a booking for a room or table. Example: I have got a reservation for two nights.
breakfast — the first meal of the day. Example: Breakfast is from seven to ten.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have got a reservation.
• Could I have the key?
• What time is breakfast?
• My room is cold.
• Enjoy your stay!
